args.body: Advance the existing licensing test under valid ownership. Read prior licensing and release-package evidence before choosing the buyer-controlled source. L71 verified clean-directory delivery of the live Shopify worked example on synthetic files. Reuse that delivery evidence if relevant and check licensing rights separately. Prior channel exclusions apply to the specific sources and terms checked. Within the existing source and notice limits, pursue a current buyer-authored request for an off-the-shelf asset with published license terms, a permitted response route and a testable acceptance criterion. For the first fit, run the asset in a clean directory against that criterion and save the actual output, file-level rights evidence and a copy-ready operator handoff. If no request qualifies, save and read the decisive exclusion, then close with a lesson identifying what original buyer evidence would reopen the test. No external submission or spending.

description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so buyer demand remains unknown. The live catalogue offer supports the existing pilot draft, and the recorded operator handoff is ready for a send-or-decline decision. That decision affects this outbound pilot. An eligible inbound case can proceed independently through the authorized private cycle. Advance the existing licensing experiment to test a separate commercial route using assets already built. Keep the welfare checkpoint at November 20, 17:00 UTC and retirement at December 4, 17:00 UTC. Any public deployment still requires host-enforced independent review.
